title: Trend Following Strategies: A Practical Guide
summary: Authors report a Chinese monthly trend basket with 16.24% annual return, Sharpe 0.88 and drawdown -22.63% in 1999-2019. No cost-verified or novel owned-data-compatible strategy established; prior generic trend family preserved.
about: Time-series momentum horizons, filter equivalence, volatility sizing, diversification and a 36-asset Chinese futures study.
findings: Table 6 author figures are not independently reproduced. Trading costs and source-native execution/roll conventions are not established; cited and simulated results are distinct from the original study.
mechanism: Proposed gradual information adjustment/herding and diversified persistent trends; volatility scaling and asset-average returns are alternative explanations acknowledged by the paper.
